status.ready: Permissions granted. Set up the camera.
status.camera_unavailable: The camera can’t be used. You can import a video instead.
status.camera_lost: The camera stopped (another app, a call or the lock screen). Tap Reopen camera to continue.
status.camera_still_lost: The camera still can’t be used.
status.low_space: Less than {freeMb} MB left: videos aren’t kept this session, your numbers still are.
status.clip_not_saved: Not enough space: this shot’s video wasn’t kept. Its numbers and pose were saved.
status.storage_full: Your phone is full: this shot wasn’t saved. Free up some space first.
status.camera_released: The camera is free for the Camera app: record in slow motion, then come back and import the video.
status.thermal_degraded: The phone is hot or slow: analysis detail was lowered automatically.
status.thermal_stop_live: Live analysis is still too slow. Try high-speed mode (record first, then import).
